newsitem.title: ITALY: Eurostat experts approved Italy Eurotax - papers.
newsitem.headline: Eurostat experts approved Italy Eurotax - papers.

text.p: Financial experts at the European Union (EU) statistics office Eurostat have given the green light to Italy's "eurotax" although the decision will be communicated formally later on Friday, Italian newspapers said.
La Repubblica newspaper said Eurostat had communicated its approval on Thursday evening and the Commission would announce its approval in a news conference today.
La Stampa daily said a Eurostat committee of financial experts had judged both the Eurotax and Italy's accounting of state guarantees to the railway as compatible with EU rules.

The eurotax is a one-off measure in the 1997 budget designed to secure Italy's entry into a single currency at its start which has been criticised as a loan and therefore not in keeping with EU accounting rules.
